body:
Might be related. When selecting method in filter method list, cursor will jump to the method. But when typing, the cursor will jump back to the selected method if there is any brief pause. Workaround is by changing opened script which clear the selected method

Occurred in 4.8dev4. Does not happen in dev3. Arch Linux. Wayland. Niri.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5888030-c5b3-499a-87dc-b36b04e6bae9

### Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878]

### Not reproducible in:
v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe]
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System
Godot v4.8.dev4 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (853x683 @ 60.02 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)


### Description:
The cursor jumps to the beginning of the selected method when the script editor idle checks for errors.


### Reproduction steps:
- open the project: [script_editor_cursor_jumps_on_idle_error_check.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31548061/script_editor_cursor_jumps_on_idle_error_check.zip)
- in the filesystem panel, double-click on: new_script.gd
- in the script editors bottom left methods panel, click on: _ready
- click on line 2
- press: space
- wait 1.5 sec


### Issue
The cursor jumps to the beginning of the _ready function.

- in the methods panel, click on: _process
- click on line 2
- press: space
- wait 1.5 sec

The cursor jumps to the beginning of the _process function.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7347b106-ecec-4d3f-a7e3-5a66c1b55c1c

### Expected
Don't move the cursor when the script editor idle checks for errors.
Like it does in:
v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe]
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d7cdce70-e95d-464b-9fbb-928e7903ab60

### Notes
1.5 sec is based on the editor setting:
text_editor/completion/idle_parse_delay
1.5 (default)

Changing it to:
- 0.1 (minimum), moves the cursor instantly
- 3, moves the cursor after 3 sec

Can reproduce. 

- Probably from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121534 which saved the selection
